Kroutrox Firiath works as a seed broker. Kroutrox Firiath resides in Zhaegaefil. Kroutrox Firiath is on the staff of Puthoum Works.
Votriam Gliatraes resides in Zoushaetiak. Stiakrox Holdings is best known for Brizas-91. Kreprou Ruzhes is on the staff of Pritil Labs. Febol Labs is led by its chief executive, Votriam Gliatraes.
